verification_policy: Every item is self-reported by the student. Neither the package nor the panel checks the student's project, video or README; a link-provided item only stores the URL the student typed. Ticks never award mastery XP and never imply an official grade.

items.text_fa: برای پروژه نتیجهٔ خوب، بهتر و بهترین را نوشتم.
items.official_quote_en: What might you consider to be a good outcome for your project? A better outcome? The best outcome?

items.text_fa: برای پروژه نقطه‌های عطف هدف گذاشتم.
items.official_quote_en: Consider making goal milestones to keep you on track.

items.text_fa: (گروهی) مشخص کردیم چه کسی چه می‌کند و دامنه دو یا سه برابر پروژهٔ یک‌نفره است.
items.official_quote_en: Inasmuch as software development is rarely a one-person effort, you are allowed an opportunity to collaborate with one or two classmates for this final project. Needless to say, it is expected that every student in any such group contribute equally to the design and implementation of that group’s project. Moreover, it is expected that the scope of a two- or three-person group’s project be, respectively, twice or thrice that of a typical one-person project.

items.text_fa: تاریخ «خوب» را دست‌کم چند هفته پیش از مهلت گذاشتم.
کد و فایل‌ها در پوشهٔ project هستند (اگر از Codespace استفاده می‌کنم).
items.official_quote_en: If using the CS50 Codespace, create a directory called project to store your project source code and other files.

items.text_fa: هر استفاده از ابزار هوش مصنوعی را در توضیحات کد ذکر کردم.
items.official_quote_en: Treat such tools as amplifying, not supplanting, your productivity. But you still must cite any use of such tools in the comments of your code.

items.text_fa: جوهر کار مال خودم (یا گروهم) است.
items.official_quote_en: For your final project (and your final project only!) it is reasonable to use AI-based software other than CS50’s own (e.g., ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, Bing Chat, et al.), but the essence of the work must still be your own.

items.text_fa: منشأ هر کد یا تکنیکی را که بیرون از درس پیدا کردم ذکر کردم.
items.official_quote_en: Failing to cite (as with comments) the origins of code or techniques that you discover outside of the course’s own lessons and integrate into your own work, even while respecting this policy’s other constraints.

items.text_fa: ویدئو حداکثر ۳ دقیقه است.
items.official_quote_en: Create a short video (that’s no more than 3 minutes in length) in which you present your project to the world.

items.text_fa: بخش آغازین ویدئو عنوان پروژه را نشان می‌دهد.
items.official_quote_en: your project’s title;

items.text_fa: بخش آغازین ویدئو نامم را نشان می‌دهد.
items.official_quote_en: your name;

items.text_fa: بخش آغازین ویدئو نام کاربری GitHub و edX را نشان می‌دهد.
items.official_quote_en: your GitHub and edX usernames;

items.text_fa: بخش آغازین ویدئو شهر و کشورم را نشان می‌دهد.
items.official_quote_en: your city and country;

items.text_fa: بخش آغازین ویدئو تاریخ ضبط ویدئو را نشان می‌دهد.
items.official_quote_en: and, the date you have recorded this video.

items.text_fa: ویدئو پروژه را در حال کار نشان می‌دهد.
items.official_quote_en: It should then go on to demonstrate your project in action, as with slides, screenshots, voiceover, and/or live action.

items.text_fa: ویدئو در YouTube (یا سایت مشابه) است و private نیست.
items.official_quote_en: it’s fine to flag it as “unlisted,” but don’t flag it as “private.”

items.text_fa: فرم رسمی را ارسال کردم.
items.official_quote_en: Submit this form!

items.text_fa: فایلی دقیقاً به نام README.md در پوشهٔ project دارم.
items.official_quote_en: Create a README.md text file (named exactly that!) in your project folder that explains your project.

items.text_fa: README.md عنوان پروژه، نشانی ویدئو و توضیح پروژه را دارد.
items.official_quote_en: This file should include your Project Title, the URL of your video (created in step 1 above) and a description of your project.

items.text_fa: README.md می‌گوید پروژه چیست و هر فایلی که نوشتم چه دارد و چه می‌کند، و تصمیم‌های طراحی را توضیح می‌دهد.
items.official_quote_en: Your README.md file should be minimally multiple paragraphs in length, and should explain what your project is, what each of the files you wrote for the project contains and does, and if you debated certain design choices, explaining why you made them.

items.text_fa: README.md چند پاراگراف و دست‌کم چند صد واژه است (حدود ۷۵۰ واژه احتمالاً کافی است).
items.official_quote_en: A README.md in the neighborhood of 750 words is likely to be sufficient for describing your project and all aspects of its functionality. If unable to reach that threshold, that probably means your project is insufficiently complex.

items.text_fa: submit50 cs50/problems/2026/x/project را از پوشهٔ پروژه اجرا کردم.
items.official_quote_en: submit50 cs50/problems/2026/x/project

items.text_fa: چند دقیقه پس از ارسال، کارنامه را در cs50.me/cs50x باز کردم.
items.official_quote_en: Be sure to visit your gradebook at cs50.me/cs50x a few minutes after you submit.

items.text_fa: بنر سبز تکمیل درس را دیدم و گواهی رایگانم را دریافت کردم.
items.official_quote_en: The course is not considered complete until you do the above and see the green banner saying you’ve completed the course.
